News Date : 05 Nov 2022News ReportFaculty Interaction was held with Dr R Sundaramurthy, CEO of Interlogicx Embedded Solutions & Director ATAL Scheme, Pondicherry State University.Interlogicx is an R/D company that offer Engineering Expertise and Create solutions mainly constructed around Embedded Hardware and Software.Interlogicx is willing to assign Funded Projects, Startups & Entrepreneurships in association with Pondicherry State University.

Faculty Interaction was held with Dr R Sundaramurthy, CEO of Interlogicx Embedded Solutions & Director ATAL Scheme, Pondicherry State University.
Interlogicx is an R/D company that offer Engineering Expertise and Create solutions mainly constructed around Embedded Hardware and Software.
Interlogicx is willing to assign Funded Projects, Startups & Entrepreneurships in association with Pondicherry State University.
